meta.title: A submitted bid cannot be discarded as a draft
gaps: The draft-discard operation is not available, so the plan cannot perform or verify the refusal of discarding the submitted bid.
warnings: a plan with only read-backs is judged by its assertions; the expected outcome is treated as accept

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: As the invited QA vendor, read the pricing round and check that Data check: “bid count” is at least 1.
words.expected: The app refuses it with “No such bid exists”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: Data check: “bid count” is at least 1.
